observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 both show the same all-black solar panel (mono-crystalline cell pattern) leaning against a wall, outdoors.
A watermark reading 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears on both images; this is a reseller/marketplace watermark, not a manufacturer brand plate.
No wattage, cell-count, or manufacturer label is visible on the panel frame or junction box in either photo.
No battery of any kind (tubular, lithium, or otherwise) is visible in either photo, despite the seller's text describing a battery's charge-holding performance.
The panel's physical condition (frame, glass, cells) appears intact and unweathered in both shots, but no close-up of the nameplate/specs sticker is given.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours, never repaired
claims.evidence: No battery appears in photo 0 or photo 1; only a solar panel is shown, so this claim cannot be matched to the pictured item at all.

claims.claim: High Quality Solar Panels, Inverters, Lithium & Tubular Batteries (general catalog claim)
claims.evidence: Generic shop-wide claim with no item-specific proof; only one panel type is shown in the two photos.

risks.risk: Wattage and cell-count of the panel are unknown, which drives most of the price difference in comparables.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate/specification sticker on the back of the panel showing watts, voltage, and cell count.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since comparables range from ~42,000 to 155,000 NGN by wattage

risks.risk: Brand/manufacturer unverified (watermark is a reseller name, not a panel maker).
risks.proof: Photo of manufacturer logo or model sticker, e.g. Canadian Solar, Longi, Jinko, Suntex etc.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/generic, at the low end of comparable wattage bracket once wattage is known

risks.risk: Panel's electrical output/condition (cracks, hotspots, actual wattage output) not demonstrated.
risks.proof: Video or photo of a multimeter/clamp meter reading under sunlight, or an inverter display showing panel output.
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested/worst case, i.e. not confirmed to produce rated output

risks.risk: The seller's text describes a battery, not a panel — suggests this may be a copy-pasted or mismatched advert, raising doubt about which item is actually for sale.
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the actual item being sold, matching the text description, or clarification from seller confirming the panel is the item in question.
risks.if_unproven: treat the panel in the photos as the only verifiable item; the battery claims are disregarded for pricing

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the panel's rear nameplate/specification sticker showing wattage, voltage, and cell count
Photo of manufacturer branding/logo on the panel
Video of panel output under sunlight via multimeter or connected inverter
Clarification/photo confirming whether a battery is also being sold, matching the text description
response.reason: The photos show only an unlabeled black solar panel with no visible wattage, cell-count, or brand markings, which are exactly the attributes that set the price among the comparables; the seller's text describes an unrelated battery, adding further mismatch that proof must resolve before even a worst-case price can be assigned.
